en: A vividly colored postcard-style illustration dominated by a large dark blue eagle standing on a sword and stone against a bright yellow sky. Below the eagle is a golden emblem and a stylized cityscape in red and orange tones. At the bottom, in ornate Gothic script, German text advertises a regional gymnastics festival in Graz in 1929. Printer information appears in small text at the upper left.
